Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 의뢰를 실패한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 점궤가 빗나가서 당황하고 있다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> seems flustered that her reading was off after failing the quest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼に失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、占いが外れて戸惑っている。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 未能完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>因为占卜失准而不知所措。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 未能完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>因為占卜失準而不知所措。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Après avoir échoué la quête, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> est déconcertée que sa prédiction ait été fausse.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ist verwirrt, weil ihre Vorhersage nach dem Scheitern der Quest falsch war.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: El personaje <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> está desconcertado porque su lectura falló al no completar la misión.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Após falhar na missão, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parece confusa, já que sua leitura estava errada.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: หลังจากทำภารกิจล้มเหลว <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็ดูจะสับสนเพราะคำทำนายของเธอผิดพลาดไปค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tampak bingung karena ramalannya meleset setelah gagal dalam misi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sau khi nhiệm vụ thất bại, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> dường như bối rối vì điểm giao thông của mình đã sai.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: मिशन में असफल होने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अपनी भविष्यवाणियां गलत होने से असमंजस में है।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Let's go back for now. I'll treat you to a meal.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: ごはん奢ってあげるから帰ろう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Je vais t'acheter à manger, on rentre.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Te daré comida, vuelve a casa.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Vou comprar comida, então vamos embora.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: พักสายสิญจน์เทนี่กลับมาแล้ว
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Tôi sẽ mua cơm cho anh, hãy về đi.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: चलो अभी वापस चलते हैं। मैं तुम्हें खाना खिलाऊँगा।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションでも飲む？
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Vous voulez que je mange ça ?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Você come a poção de cura?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: คุณอยากกินพลังงานเพิ่มไหม?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Apakah mau memakan potion kehidupan juga?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Có muốn uống thuốc hồi sức không?

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> begged me to treat her to a meal, willing to accept even a cheap bowl of noodles.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、立ち食いそばでいいから奢ってほしいとせがんだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>缠着我说，就算是便宜的面也没关系，要我请客。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>纏著我說，就算是便宜的麵也沒關係，要我請客。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> m'a suppliée de lui offrir un repas, acceptant même un bol de nouilles bon marché.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bettelte darum, zum Essen eingeladen zu werden, und sagte, dass sogar eine billige Nudelsuppe in Ordnung wäre.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> me pidió que lo invitaran a comer, incluso aceptando un tazón de fideos barato.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> implorou para que eu comprasse um macarrão barato.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>อ้อนวอนให้ฉันเลี้ยงข้าวเธอ แม้จะเป็นบะหมี่ราคาถูกๆ ก็ตามค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> memohon agar aku mentraktirnya makan, bahkan rela menerima semangkuk mi murah.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> nài nỉ tôi đãi cô ấy một bữa, dù chỉ là một bát mì rẻ tiền cũng được.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने मुझसे खाने के लिए मिन्नतें की, यहां तक कि एक सस्ते नूडल्स के कटोरे के लिए भी तैयार थी।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 급하게 밥을 먹다가 조금 체하고 말았다...
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: In her hurry to eat, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ended up with a stomachache...
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、急いで食べたせいで胃もたれしてしまった…
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>因为吃得太急，有点消化不良了…
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>因為吃得太急，有點消化不良了…
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Pressée de manger, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a fini par avoir mal au ventre…
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: In ihrer Eile, zu essen, bekam <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> eine Magenverstimmung...
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Por la prisa de comer, a <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se le indigestó un poco...
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> comi apressadamente e fiquei um pouco indisposto...
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ด้วยความรีบร้อนที่จะกิน <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> เลยปวดท้อง...
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Vì ăn vội vàng, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã bị khó tiêu…
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: जल्दी खाने के चक्कर में, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> को अपच हो गया...

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est illuminée après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> freute sich, nachdem er den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó después de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou depois de receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ดูสดใสขึ้นหลังจากได้รับยาค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> langsung ceria setelah menerima ramuan itu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tươi tỉnh hẳn lên sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: पोशन मिलने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> का चेहरा खिल उठा।
